{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
total_rows = len(df)
qa_rows = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

print(f"Total rows: {total_rows}")
print(f"QA rows found: {len(qa_rows)}")
print(f"QA rows: {qa_rows[['order_id', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean']]}")

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"\nMean revenue of completed orders (after QA removal): {mean_revenue:.2f}")

# Output the result
mean_revenue"}
